story: AI Creates Detailed 3D Renderings from Thousands of Tourist Photos
text: I have been spending some time on the Virtual Reality version of Google Earth, and it is amazing to see the world in 3D from inside. Here there is a video on how Google creates the 3D for Google Earth: [VIDEO] I hope to see more of this technologies as it is great to visit places without leaving home.

story: Google deploying planes over cities for 3D maps (2012)
